id: Austin Powers: International Man of Mystery (1997)

facts.text: My demands are simple, Number Two. A full plate, a second helping, and nobody touches my dessert.
facts.why: Dr Evil never says this. It is not on the Wikiquote page and his demands in the film are about ransom and sharks with laser beams. It is not printed on this layout, but it sits in the data and could surface later.
facts.fix: Eat up, Number Two. I figure every creature deserves a warm meal.
